tools.name: submit_backtest
tools.description: Submit a backtest to the firm's engine. Builds a complete, engine-valid .request file from a proven-accepted baseline template plus the overrides you supply, stages it atomically as SIMULATION_REQUESTS_DIR/<job_name>.request for the existing cluster watcher, and returns job_name/submitted_at plus the concrete handoff paths to poll with get_backtest_status. Supply ONLY the parameters that change for this run; all standard configuration and infrastructure values (cluster URLs, data/master-index paths, holiday calendars, expert weights, etc.) are inherited verbatim from the baseline - do not re-specify them. The baseline template itself is supplied by the runtime (via the BACKTEST_BASELINE env var), typically the .request file attached to the Jira comment; if none is given it falls back to the default baseline at templates/value_growth_factor.request. IMPORTANT: if the run needs a specific or the most recent data universe, call list_master_indices FIRST and pass the chosen version as master_indices (together with the universe / short_stock_defs / short_indice_defs reported for it); never hardcode master-index paths or guess dataset versions. Set dry_run=true to build and validate the request WITHOUT submitting (returns the generated request for inspection).

job_name.description: Unique run identifier - becomes the staged <job_name>.request filename and results directory name (e.g. 'alpha_momentum_v1'). Letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens only; any whitespace causes the model-builder to reject the job.

start_date.description: Backtest start date (STARTDATE), YYYY-MM-DD. Overrides the baseline if given.

end_date.description: Backtest end date (ENDDATE), YYYY-MM-DD. Overrides the baseline if given.

atrade_sifting_commons.description: Git branch/tag for the atrade_sifting_commons component. Omit to inherit the baseline.

atrade_sifting_pretrade.description: Git branch/tag for atrade_sifting_pretrade. Omit to inherit the baseline.

atrade_sifting_portfolio.description: Git branch/tag for atrade_sifting_portfolio. Omit to inherit the baseline.

atrade_sifting_hedge.description: Git branch/tag for atrade_sifting_hedge. Omit to inherit the baseline.

atrade_sifting_model.description: Git branch/tag for atrade_sifting_model. Omit to inherit the baseline.

atrade_sifting_config.description: Git branch/tag for atrade_sifting_config. Omit to inherit the baseline. (The six atrade_sifting_* components may point at different branches; set only the ones your task changes.)

nport.description: Number of stocks in the portfolio (NPORT). Overrides the baseline.

nfreq.description: Rebalancing frequency in weeks (NFREQ). Overrides the baseline.

ndelay.description: Signal delay in days (NDELAY). Overrides the baseline.

slippage.description: Transaction cost / slippage as a fraction (SLIPPAGE). Overrides the baseline.

initcash.description: Initial cash in base currency units (INITCASH). Overrides the baseline.

value_active_rules.description: Comma-separated rule IDs for the Value factor (VALUE_ACTIVE_RULES), e.g. '4,5'. Overrides the baseline.

carry_active_rules.description: Comma-separated rule IDs for the Carry factor (CARRY_ACTIVE_RULES), e.g. '0' to disable. Overrides the baseline.

master_indices.description: The master-indices version to use (e.g. '2026-06-08_2.9.0-RELEASE_pyspark'), obtained from list_master_indices. Sets the version directory and the matching runner_dataURL. Pair it with universe / short_stock_defs / short_indice_defs (also reported by list_master_indices for that version) to fill the exact stock-definition files. Call list_master_indices first; omit to inherit the baseline's (which may be outdated).

universe.description: Filename of the longStockDefs file to use as the trading universe (e.g. 'longStockDefsEU_exUK_inPrimaryShareClass_exBlackListed_trimmed.txt'). Pick one from the longStockDefs list that list_master_indices reports for the chosen master_indices version (a version may offer several universe variants). Used only when master_indices is given; omit to reuse the baseline's universe filename.

short_stock_defs.description: Filename of the shortStockDefs file for the chosen master_indices version (from list_master_indices), e.g. 'shortStockDefs.txt'. Used only when master_indices is given; omit to reuse the baseline's.

short_indice_defs.description: Filename of the shortIndiceDefs file for the chosen master_indices version (from list_master_indices), e.g. 'shortIndiceDefs.txt'. Used only when master_indices is given; omit to reuse the baseline's.

extra_params.description: Additional .request KEY=value pairs to set or override, passed straight through to the request file (e.g. test-only parameters a feature branch introduces). Forward-compatible: new engine parameters can be used here without changing this tool. Not validated against a whitelist.

remove_keys.description: List of .request keys to DELETE entirely - the whole line is dropped from the baseline (e.g. ['ACTIVE_HARD_PRESCREENER_RULES']). Use only when a parameter must be ABSENT, not just disabled; to turn a factor off prefer setting its *_ACTIVE_RULES to 0. A key listed here is removed even if also set elsewhere.

dry_run.description: If true, build and return the generated .request for inspection WITHOUT delivering it to the engine. Default false.

tools.name: list_master_indices
tools.description: List the master-index data pools currently available on the cluster. Each pool defines the stock universe a backtest runs on (long/short stock definitions and short-indice definitions), versioned by data-snapshot date and release; the matching ETL data version (runner_dataURL) shares that date/release and is returned with it. Call this BEFORE submit_backtest whenever a run should use a specific or the most recent universe, then pass the chosen 'version' into submit_backtest's master_indices - this prevents hardcoding outdated paths or guessing dataset versions. Read-only; changes nothing. Returns a list of pools, each with: version, date, release, the longStockDefs/shortStockDefs/shortIndiceDefs filename LISTS (longStockDefs often has several universe variants - pick one and pass it to submit_backtest as 'universe'), the matching runner_dataURL, and is_latest.

latest_only.description: If true, return only the single most recent pool. Default false (return all available pools).

filter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to filter pools by version id (e.g. a date '2026-05' or a release).

tools.name: get_backtest_status
tools.description: Check whether a submitted backtest job has finished. Polls the simulation-results directory: a directory named after the job is considered completed only after it contains resultsTable.csv; a plain file with the same name means the model-builder rejected the request (file content contains the reason). Call this repeatedly until status is 'completed', 'rejected', or 'timeout' before calling get_backtest_logs.

submitted_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp returned by submit_backtest. Used to compute elapsed time for timeout detection.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds after submission before the job is considered timed out. Defaults to 5400 (1.5 hours). Most successful backtests finish within 1800-3600 seconds.

tools.name: get_backtest_logs
tools.description: Extract and parse results for a completed backtest. Unzips the results archive found in the job's results directory, runs the cluster parse script, and returns key performance metrics (Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, annualised return, volatility, total return) along with the path to all parsed output files for further analysis or equity curve generation. Only call this after get_backtest_status has returned 'completed'.

job_name.description: The job_name of a completed backtest (get_backtest_status returned 'completed').
